svg.title: AAHA canine vaccine timeline with the Ontario rabies start
svg.desc: A timeline for dogs drawn from the 2022 AAHA canine vaccination table: combination doses between 6 and 16 weeks, leptospirosis from 12 weeks, a dose within one year, then three-year combination boosters and annual leptospirosis. Ontario rabies duty starts at three months and follows the certificate date.
svg.text: AAHA 2022 canine table, 2024 leptospirosis note. Ontario rabies from Regulation 567. Not a cat schedule.
Leptospirosis boosters on the AAHA table are annual after the initial series. Rabies follows the certificate, not this drawing.
DAP means distemper, adenovirus, and parvovirus, with or without parainfluenza. Doses are 2 to 4 weeks apart.
Ontario SPCA lists DA2PP, leptospirosis, and rabies at 33 dollars a dose. That price is not drawn, because dose counts differ.
Your veterinarian applies the interval. A titre is not, on the CVMA statement, a replacement for vaccination.
Saving Optimizer, 26 Sep 2026. Confirm the certificate date for rabies.
